response.text:
Here are the deadlines and dates in October 2026, soonest first. Payments are listed separately below.

**Deadlines and appointments**
- Return overdue library media, due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Ordnung's send-by date for it is Mon 28 Sep 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. After the due date, fees rise per item per opening day.
- Dental check-up and cleaning, Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_0jf0fq5r5ydx]. Arrive 10 minutes early and bring your health insurance card.
- Cancel the residence permit appointment if you can't attend. Ordnung has this due Fri 9 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- Residence permit extension appointment, Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. Bring your passport, enrolment certificate, proof of funds, health insurance proof, biometric photo and tenancy agreement or landlord confirmation. The letter says the permit ends if the extension isn't applied for before expiry.
- Optional objection (Widerspruch) against the Muster BKK contribution notice, due Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Ordnung's send-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. An objection does not suspend payment.
- Mobile contract FunkNetz Smart M: the cancellation must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. Post it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. The current term ends Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

**Payments**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt]. The amount was read from a scan, so the letter says "€30.00". Please check it against the paper letter. If it isn't paid, a fine proceeding follows with extra costs. The send-by date is Thu 1 Oct 2026 [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt].
- Rent, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Additional service charges for 2025, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n]. Send-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Residence permit extension fee, due Wed 14 Oct 2026: 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. Pay on site by girocard, because cash isn't accepted.
- Electricity advance payment, collected by direct debit Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w].
- Health and care insurance contribution, direct debit Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- Gym membership, direct debit Thu 1 Oct 2026: 29.90 € [item:itm_chhc59r0d16v].
- Deutschlandticket, direct debit Thu 1 Oct 2026: 63.00 € [item:itm_2s90qr4prp13].
- Your scholarship stipend of 450.00 € is due in on Thu 1 Oct 2026 [item:itm_j2650a27bsty].

The library return and the parking fee are the most urgent, since both fall in the first days of October. You can use "Mark done" in Ordnung once you've handled an item.
